correctness.rationale: Using the normalized three Hermite functions, direct Gaussian integration proves the exact A(t) matrix and the trace expression. Differentiation yields a scalar critical equation. The transformed critical function H has derivative with sign governed by p(z)=64z^6+144z^4-32z^3-36z^2-120z+15. Descartes plus evaluations at 0, 1/4 and 1 prove two simple positive p roots; H(0)=0, H(1)<0 and H(infinity)=sqrt(pi) give exactly two positive V critical thresholds. An exact derivative factorization proves decreasing e^{-2t^2}U(t) for t>1. Fraction arithmetic proves beta<129/100 and e^{-2(129/100)^2}U(129/100)>3/2, hence V(beta)<V(0). All critical points and global ranking follow without reliance on numeric scanning. The packaged checker verifies algebraic identities, rational certificates and supplementary quadrature.
